messages.text: can you say where the order will be shipped from?

Hi Tom. Your BS-4 on Shop···· doesn't go through our warehouse, it ships direct from the manufacturer to you in (address hidden). We wrote on the 31st that it's packed and finished final testing, and it leaves Monday, November 2. Tracking comes to (email hidden) as soon as the label is on the box.
just trying to get idea on time it will take to get to me. Can you sya the shipper company ?

I can't name the carrier yet, Tom. It gets picked when the label is made Monday, and the tracking number comes to you in the same email. Past BS-4 shipments have gone out on a tracked service you follow through 17track. I don't have a transit time I'd trust until that first scan shows the carrier, so I won't guess at days. As soon as it's labelled I can tell you exactly who has it.
Before you go, one thing: what made you put the credit toward the BS-4 rather than take another NerdOctaxe?
i would have if they were in stock and you knew when it would be restocked but when i asked yu could not give me an answer when it restocks so i paid a bit more to get the 18ths one bs-4

That's fair, an open-ended wait is hard to sit on.

So was it the unknown restock date that decided it, or had you already been eyeing the extra hashrate the BS-4 gives you?
tbh i think this bs-4 is 'uglier' than the octaxe. i am ok with my choice now that it is done

Ha, the Octaxe did have the nicer screen. Thanks for telling me, that's genuinely useful.

Your BS-4 leaves the manufacturer Monday and the tracking comes to your email. Enjoy the extra hashrate, Tom.
i would be sad if it came back in stock next tuesday

I understand, but I still have no restock date for the NerdOctaxe, and nothing says it's landing next week.

Either way you're ahead: 18 TH/s against the Octaxe's 12, and a brand new unit under warranty rather than a replacement of one that died on you. I'd have made the same call.
i was joking about tuesday restock. i will wait until it get here and the screen on the octaxe was not why i like it better it was the 7 fans it has and looks more sleek

Got it, the fan wall is the look you liked. Noted, Tom, that's the kind of thing worth us knowing.

Tracking lands in your inbox once it's labelled Monday. Shout here if anything looks off when it arrives.
